verdict.rationale: Databricks offers separate isolated spaces for experimentation: a no-cost Free Edition workspace for experimenting, sample data in Unity Catalog, and the AI Playground for prototyping agents. Unity Catalog access control and Delta time-travel rollback limit the damage from mistakes against real tables. However, nothing documents a dedicated sandbox or staging environment, data cloning, or a test mode for agents that keeps them away from production data. Missing for 10: documented sandbox/staging environments or data cloning for safe testing, agent-specific isolation from production data, hands-on corroboration.
